text:
There are x biscuits in a pack.
Adam eats 2 of the biscuits.
He divides the remaining biscuits between his 5 friends.
Each friend gets 3 biscuits.
Form an equation and solve it to find the value of x.
x =  .................................................. [3]
subject: International Mathematics
